body: 26.2 flipped from ALPHA to STABLE today. Founder, live while connected from Bedrock: 'no upgrade now lets see what happens.' Downloaded build 97, checksum-verified via PaperMC's Fill API, swapped into start.sh, restarted. Clean boot, all 3 plugins (Geyser/Floodgate/ViaVersion) reloaded without error, Geyser rebound 19133 correctly.
title: Upgrade to Paper 26.2 (build 97, STABLE)
